changes_made.explanation: Removed redundant dataset entry and 'English' from languages (paper generates Verilog code, not English text). Removed duplicate output description. The paper focuses on hardware description language (HDL) code generation.
Consolidated all MMD variants under 'MMD' metric. Simplified metric names to base forms. Removed 'logic depth distribution' as it's not a metric but a characteristic being measured.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation is used in the paper. LLMs are only used for generation (GPT-4o-mini for code generation and function analysis), not for evaluating outputs.
No human evaluation is mentioned in the paper. All evaluations are automated using circuit statistics and AI model performance metrics.

overall_notes: This paper focuses on hardware description language (HDL) code generation for integrated circuits, specifically Verilog code. While it uses LLMs for generation, it's primarily a hardware/circuit design paper rather than traditional NLG. The evaluation focuses on circuit characteristics (syntax validity, structural similarity) rather than linguistic quality. The extracted metadata was generally accurate but needed normalization and removal of redundant entries.
